Time interval from corticosteroids to delivery
time interval from corticosteroids administration to delivery
Diabetic mothers undergoing early term scheduled cesarean section
cohort: 1165 neonates born to diabetic mothers undergoing early term (37+0 to 38+6 weeks) scheduled cesarean section
finding: In diabetic mothers undergoing early term scheduled cesarean section, antenatal corticosteroid administration was not associated with decreased risks of RDS/TTN, and delivery within 2 days of administration was associated with an increased risk of neonatal hypoglycemia.
